text:
Ava: Draft for the product launch blog is up — quick pass pls. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/product-launch-hero-v3
Marco: looking now. do we have final hero image?
Ava: not yet — @Marco can you make a 1200x628 and 800x450 variant? Need both for socials and the blog hero.
Jen: sending legal checklist — pulling the compliance callouts. main ask: avoid absolute performance claim without benchmark link.
Ravi: flagged the benchmark table in the doc (section 4) — numbers are from internal perf harness, okay to link but recommend adding method note.
Olivia: CTA matrix needed for webinar signups -> which flows map to hubspot lists?
Tom: HubSpot list mapping below — use lists: "Product Launch Leads", "Benchmark Attendees". Will create and share IDs by tomorrow.
Ava: thanks. also want to test two CTA variants: Register Webinar / Read Benchmarks. Marco can you wire both CTAs into the hero design?
Marco: yep. I'll export assets and include hover states. ETA EOD Thu.
Jen: quick legal note: change "fastest" to "among the fastest" and add link to methodology. Also remove competitor callouts.
Ava: good catch. I'll update the copy now.
Ravi: small nit — in the benchmark table, call out the model variants used (quantized vs fp16). Put a footnote with config snippet.
Ava: adding footnote and a code snippet for reproducibility.
Ava: ```
# benchmark config
model: redwood-2.1-bench
sequence_length: 512
.batching: dynamic
quantization: int8
```
Marco: design looks cleaner with that footnote layout.
Olivia: for UTM tracking, use utm_source=redwood_blog, utm_campaign=launch_q2, utm_content=cta_variantA/B
Tom: Confirmed — I'll add redirect endpoints so hubspot captures utm_content into the lists.
Ava: timeline: final copy by Fri 4pm PT, design assets by Fri EOD, legal signoff by Fri 2pm. Can everyone meet that?
Jen: Friday 1pm works for legal signoff.
Marco: yes for assets.
Ravi: I'll review the benchmark language by Fri noon.
Olivia: I'll prep the webinar registration page and prefill GA events.
Tom: HubSpot lists created, IDs: 4521, 4522. Sharing in DM.
Ava: sweet. last thing — internal quick preview for execs before publish. Can PublishBot generate a staging preview once assets are in?
PublishBot: preview created at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/launch-1718509999 (expires in 48h) :white_check_mark:
Ava: perfect. please drop any final copy comments here. I'll do a clean handoff to growth ops once legal signs off. :rocket:
Marco: one last request — can we include a short CTA variant that says "See live numbers" for the benchmark-first audience?
Olivia: good idea — variant C for the landing page. I'll add to registration tests.
Jen: final legal thumbs up pending the wording tweaks. will ping when done. :thumbsup:
Ravi: added a short note about dataset disclaimers.
Ava: thanks team — feel free to react to the doc rather than thread. I'll follow up with a swallow list for publish steps after legal thumbs. :eyes:
